basic.name: 普通攻击：高压火枪
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段攻击，随后向前发起强力火刀攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, followed by a powerful flame blade strike, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：热血满膛
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前突刺并进行尾巴攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Thrust forward and perform a tail attack, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：小心脚下
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行激光扫射，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接普通攻击中的强力火刀攻击；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a sweeping laser attack forward, dealing Fire DMG.
After using this skill, immediately follow up with the powerful fire blade from the Basic Attack.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：反攻战机
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：枪管过热
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前发动旋转攻击，然后向前方发射激光，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 points of Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：与火共舞
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前发动旋转攻击，然后向前方发射激光，造成火属性伤害;

招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.
Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：炙刃炽铳
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：沸热穿刺

facts.text: 开始喷射时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: When firing begins, triggers Quick Assist.

facts.text: 跃向空中时，将触发[快速支援]，若响应[快速支援]，奥菲丝&「鬼火」会延长激光喷射的持续时间；
facts.textEn: When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.

facts.text:
奥菲丝&「鬼火」的暴击率提升25%，[追加攻击]造成的伤害提升85%；
奥菲丝&「鬼火」初始获得100点[蓄炎]，最多获得125点；
奥菲丝&「鬼火」处于后台时，若可释放[特殊技：蚀光一闪]且能量大于等于60点时，改为消耗30点能量自动释放[强化特殊技：灼红旋涡];
[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]的激光命中敌人时，使全队角色获得[准星聚焦]效果，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，代理人拥有[准星聚焦]效果时，攻击力提升280点，当奥菲丝&「鬼火」的初始能量自动回复大于等于1.6点时，超过的部分每拥有0.1点初始能量自动回复，攻击力额外提升20点，初始提升与额外提升总共不超过700点，拥有[准星聚焦]的代理人发动[追加攻击]时，将会使自身的[准星聚焦]效果延长4秒，最多延长20秒；
[普通攻击：高压火枪]的火刀攻击、[强化特殊技：小心脚下]、[强化特殊技：灼红旋涡]、[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]、[强化特殊技：燥焰迸射]、[连携技：枪管过热]、[终结技：与火共舞]造成的伤害均视为追加攻击伤害，发动上述招式视为发动[追加攻击]。
facts.textEn:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by 25%, and Aftershock DMG increases by 85%.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by 280. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed 700. When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.

cinema.name: 豪华猫屋
cinema.description: 奥菲丝&「鬼火」发动[特殊技：蚀光一闪]、[强化特殊技：灼红旋涡]、[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]、[强化特殊技：燥焰迸射]造成的伤害无视15%火属性伤害抗性，且拥有[准星聚焦]的代理人攻击造成的伤害提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's Fire RES, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.

cinema.name: 怪味食品清单
cinema.description: 奥菲丝&「鬼火」每次发动[追加攻击]时回复65点喧响值，4秒内最多触发一次；奥菲丝&「鬼火」发动[终结技]后，自身的攻击力提升20%，最多持续45秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Orphie & Magus launch an Aftershock, restore 65 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 4s. After Orphie & Magus use their Ultimate, their ATK increases by 20% for up to 45s.

cinema.name: 《战术手册》

cinema.descriptionEn: Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.

持续喷射一段时间后将会加大火力，使得招式的打断等级大幅提升；
喷射期间受到攻击时，将会招架敌人的攻击，并直接加大火力；
喷射达到最大时间时，自动发动[强化特殊技：燥焰迸射]；
低火力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害减少40%，高火力期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
When Bottled Heat is greater than or equal to 100, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 100 Bottled Heat to continuously fire a laser forward, dealing Fire DMG.
When firing begins, triggers Quick Assist.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：燥焰迸射
ex.description:
[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]喷射至最大时间后自动发动：
向前发动旋转攻击，然后向前方发射激光，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Heat Charge reaches maximum firing time:
Performs a spinning attack forward, then fires a laser ahead dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：与火共舞
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前发动旋转攻击，然后向前方发射激光，造成火属性伤害;
跃向空中时，将触发[快速支援]，若响应[快速支援]，奥菲丝&「鬼火」会延长激光喷射的持续时间；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.
Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：焦痕劈斩
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
130100004.descriptionEn:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
